measurements.name: m_hi_n

measurements.name: m_lo_n

measurements.name: m_eh

measurements.name: m_el
measurements.comment: eye low level: worst differential 0-bit sample at the stated phase

measurements.name: m_vhi
measurements.comment: observer: differential window maximum

measurements.name: m_vlo
measurements.comment: observer: differential window minimum

measurements.name: m_eye_h_v
measurements.comment: E9 eye height at the stated sampling phase = worst 1-bit sample minus worst 0-bit sample

measurements.comment: intermediate: differential normalized to its window extremes
